_agents_index: Example MCP client configuration wiring an MCP-capable agent to the internal Grafana MCP server through the single edge port, with no credential to paste.
_comment: Copy this file to your project root, or merge the grafana entry into your existing .mcp.json. It carries no credential and no absolute path: the server holds the Grafana login internally, so nothing is pasted here. The url uses the default port 24317; if you set EDGE_PORT to another value, change the port in the url to match. See the README section 'The agent interface' for where to place this file for a project or for a whole machine, and for the stdio alternative.
